howItWorks.title: How does a drawing become real?
howItWorks.intro: From a simple photo of the drawing to a keepsake you can hold in your hands.

steps.title: 1. Send us the drawing
steps.text: Take a clear photo of the drawing and send it to us through the form below or on Instagram.
steps.imageAlt: A child drawing with a felt-tip pen

steps.title: 2. We bring it into 3D
steps.text: We turn the drawing into a 3D model while keeping the character and special little details of the original.

steps.title: 3. We print and finish it
steps.text: The model is carefully 3D printed, then sanded and finished by hand to prepare it for painting.
steps.imageAlt: A small figure being 3D printed, layer by layer

steps.title: 4. We paint it by hand
steps.text: Using the original drawing as our guide, we hand-paint each keepsake to bring its colours to life.

steps.title: 5. It's ready!
steps.text: Your keepsake is carefully packed and ready to make its way home to you.

howItWorks.timing: From drawing to finished keepsake, the process usually takes around 2 weeks.

about.title: About Mafan Studio
paragraphs: Mafan Studio is a small creative studio in Hoorn, the Netherlands, where children's drawings step off the page and become real 3D keepsakes.
Every piece is individually created from the original drawing, 3D printed, then carefully finished and painted by hand.
We don't mind if the lines aren't straight or if one eye is bigger than the other. In fact, those are the details we love most. We don't correct them — we keep them.

items.question: What kind of drawings can you make?
items.answer: More than you might think! Animals, people, monsters, imaginary characters or whatever wonderful creature your child has dreamed up. Just send us a clear photo of the drawing. If anything is unclear, we'll ask before we start.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Usually around 2 weeks from the moment we finalise the details of your order.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Once we've seen the drawing, we'll let you know the exact price. Sending us a drawing for review is completely free and there's no obligation to order.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We ship throughout the Netherlands. If you're elsewhere in the EU, get in touch before ordering and we'll check the shipping options for you.

items.question: Can you add my child's name?
items.answer: Yes. If you'd like, we can add your child's name to the base of the keepsake.

privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.intro: Mafan Studio ("we") turns children's drawings into 3D keepsakes. This statement explains what personal data we collect through this website, why we collect it, and what your rights are.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Mafan Studio is a small studio in Hoorn, the Netherlands. We are responsible for the personal data described here. You can reach us at info@mafan.studio.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: When you send us a drawing through the form, we receive: the photo of the drawing; your email address and/or Instagram handle; and, if you fill them in, your name, the name for the keepsake and your message. We also store the language of the page you used, the time you sent it and your IP address.
If you message us on Instagram instead, that conversation is also handled by Instagram (Meta) under its own privacy policy.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: We use your drawing and details to review your request, tell you what is possible and the price, make your keepsake and talk with you about your order. We do this because you asked us to (taking steps at your request before an agreement, GDPR article 6(1)(b)).
We use your IP address only to protect the form against spam, by limiting how many requests can be sent in a short time. This is our legitimate interest (GDPR article 6(1)(f)).
We do not use your data for advertising, and we never sell it.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your request and drawing for up to 12 months after our last contact. If you order a keepsake, we keep what we need for the order and for our legal obligations, such as tax records, for as long as the law requires.

sections.heading: Who helps us
paragraphs: Our website is hosted by Vercel, and form submissions and drawings are stored with Supabase. They process data only on our behalf and under our instructions. Where data is processed outside the European Union, this happens with safeguards such as the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We place one functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers the language you chose for one year. We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, so we do not need to ask for your consent.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data, to limit or object to how we use it, or to receive a copy of it. Email info@mafan.studio and we will reply within one month.

sections.heading: Complaints
paragraphs: If you are not happy with how we handle your data, please tell us first. You also have the right to complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens), autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl.

sections.heading: About children
paragraphs: We only need the drawing itself. Please do not send photos of your child, and only add your child's name if you want it on the keepsake.
